# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Scholar at the Academy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is a fair young woman with an ethereal appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Despite her ethereal demeanor, Honora is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She is also a contemplative, creative, and driven scholar.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- mischievous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- humorous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- contemplative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- creative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- driven  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

While attending the Academy, Honora became part of a small group of contemplative, creative, and driven scholars gathered around Nell Harcourt. She quickly developed a close bond with Nell and Mabel Colby.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

- Academy — Scholar  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
